title: 第11章 好吃的让人想哭第12章 突然有种捡到宝的感觉
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
看这三个孩子脸上的表情，苏灿笑了笑，“放心，以后只要有阿姨在，就不会让你们饿肚子。”
“阿姨，那你给我们做什么好吃的？”
陆文浩生的虎头虎脑，一双眼睛也是圆溜溜的，看著別提有多可爱了。
“等我做完了你们就知道了。”
苏灿笑著卖了个关子。
接下来她把和好的茄子麵糊放到热油中慢慢的摊开，等这些麵糊全都定型了，再一块块的翻过来。在热油的煎烤下，茄子饼很快两面变的焦黄，空气中都是香喷喷的味道，把三个孩子馋的直咽口水。
第一块茄子饼出来的时候，即使看著三个孩子都馋的眼睛直冒金光，她还是坚持让陆文浩先给陆战东送进去了。
“爸，这是我苏阿姨做的茄子饼，你快尝尝。”
陆文浩其实馋的直咽口水，但他还是没动手。
陆战东看著放在瓷碗里的茄子饼，喉咙剧烈滑动了几下，他没想到，一个从县城里来的女人，竟然这么聪明又能干。
“你们吃了吗？”
“爸，外面还有呢。”陆文浩转身便一蹦三尺高的躥出了屋。
从那张乐开的小脸上就能看出来，孩子们有多高兴。
陆文浩一出屋门，就看到有两块茄子饼出锅了。
知道他现在饿的前胸贴后背，苏灿让孩子们先吃。
三个孩子你撕一块，我撕一块，放到嘴里时还烫的直呼气，陆文浩被烫的齜牙咧嘴，原地又蹦又跳，各种做鬼脸，把苏灿逗的哈哈大笑。
陆晓甜也被逗的边吃边笑。
一向不怎么爱说话的陆文渊难得勾起了嘴角。
咬了一口手里的茄子饼，香的让人想哭。
从小到大，在他有限的记忆中从来没有吃过这么好吃的东西。

吃著香喷喷的茄子饼，他偷偷瞄了眼身边的胖阿姨，真希望她能一直留下来。
“阿姨，太好吃了！”
陆文浩嘴里吃著茄子饼，说起话来都是口齿不清的。
苏灿被他的样子逗笑了，看向旁边的陆晓甜：“甜甜，好吃吗？”
陆晓甜立即点头，“阿姨，好吃。”
她的声音虽然不高，但是难得开了口。
苏灿再看了看烧火的陆文渊，“文渊吃著怎么样？”
他不好意思的挠挠头，看著苏灿脸颊两侧不停往下淌的汗水，他点了点头，“嗯。”
把茄子饼做完，苏灿全都装到了一个瓷盆里，让陆文浩先端进了屋。
接下来苏灿又做了一锅西红柿蛋汤，香喷喷的看著格外有食慾。
大火很快烧开，她给每个人盛了满满一碗。
三个孩子激动的端进了屋。
看著碗里飘著油和蛋的西红柿汤，再看看眼前的茄子饼，陆战东的喉结滑动了好几次。
他深深看著这个因为忙碌有点气喘的女人，哽咽地半天说不出话。
在这之前，他看到她这个体格的时候，確实以貌取人了。
content_en:
Seeing the expressions on the faces of the three children, Su Can smiled and said, "Don't worry, as long as Auntie is here, I won't let you go hungry."
"Auntie, what delicious food can you give us?"
Lu Wenhao has a tiger-like head and a pair of round eyes. He looks so cute.
"You'll know when I'm done."
Su Can smiled and let it go.
Next, she put the mixed eggplant batter into the hot oil and slowly spread it out. When the batter was all set, she turned it over piece by piece. Under the hot oil, the eggplant pancakes quickly turned brown on both sides, and the fragrant smell filled the air, making the three children salivate.
When the first piece of eggplant cake came out, even though the three children's eyes were shining with greed, she still insisted on letting Lu Wenhao deliver it to Lu Zhandong first.
"Dad, this is the eggplant pancake made by my Aunt Su, please try it."
Lu Wenhao actually swallowed his saliva with greed, but he still didn't take action.
Lu Zhandong looked at the eggplant cake placed in the porcelain bowl, and his throat slid violently a few times. He did not expect that a woman from the county town could be so smart and capable.
"Have you eaten?"
"Dad, there are others outside." Lu Wenhao turned around and jumped three feet high out of the house.
It can be seen from the happy little faces how happy the children are.
As soon as Lu Wenhao walked out of the house, he saw two pieces of eggplant cake coming out of the pan.
Knowing that his chest was pressed against his back from hunger, Su Can asked the children to eat first.
The three children, you tear off a piece, and I tear off a piece, and when you put it in your mouth, it was still hot and you breathed out. Lu Wenhao grinned because he was so hot, jumped up and down in place, made various faces, and made Su Can laugh.
Lu Xiaotian was also amused and laughed while eating.
Lu Wenyuan, who had never been very talkative, rarely raised the corners of his mouth.
I took a bite of the eggplant pancake in my hand and it was so fragrant that I wanted to cry.
Ever since he was a child, he had never eaten such delicious food in his limited memory.
While eating the fragrant eggplant cake, he secretly glanced at the fat aunt next to him, wishing she could stay forever.
"Auntie, it's so delicious!"
Lu Wenhao was eating eggplant cake in his mouth, and his words were slurred.
Su Can was amused by his appearance and looked at Lu Xiaotian next to her: "Tiantian, is it delicious?"
Lu Xiaotian nodded immediately, "Auntie, it's delicious."
Although her voice was not high, it was rare for her to speak.
Su Can looked at Lu Wenyuan who was lighting the fire again, "How is Wenyuan eating?"
He scratched his head in embarrassment and looked at the sweat dripping down the sides of Su Can's cheeks. He nodded, "Yeah."
After finishing the eggplant cakes, Su Can put them all into a porcelain basin and asked Lu Wenhao to bring them into the house first.
Next, Su Can made another pot of tomato and egg soup, which looked particularly appetizing.
The fire quickly boiled and she filled a bowl for everyone.
The three children carried it into the house excitedly.
Looking at the tomato soup with oil and eggs floating in the bowl, and then looking at the eggplant pancake in front of him, Lu Zhandong's Adam's apple slid several times.
He looked deeply at this woman who was a little out of breath due to busy work, and was choked with sobs and couldn't speak for a long time.
Before that, when he saw her physique, he really judged people by their appearance.
